note: Drafted on 2026-11-15 by an AI session under D34 of issue #77, for rotation B. D194 of issue #77: h_BG for the roots and rhizodeposits; the scope is the origin "wheat_belowground" that EP4 writes on main for the crop_id wheat (<crop_id>_aboveground, <crop_id>_belowground), which engine/amg/entry.py reads under the scope key crop (ORIGIN_SCOPE_KEY). Row: the spring wheat row, as D142 and D197 of issue #77 take it; the row "MC, Winter wheat" prints the same h_AG, h_BG, C_conc_AG and C_conc_BG. Verbatim row to compare, parameters_PLANT.tab: "MC,Spring wheat,Blé de printemps,C3,0.425,0.409,0.101,0.066,0.96,0.51,7.517,0.5,0.217,0.4,0.44,0.4,Solebiom project" (header "Crop_type,Crop_name,Crop_name_FR,Plant_group,RP,RS,RR,RE,Beta,HI,SR,PSS,h_AG,h_BG,C_conc_AG,C_conc_BG,Source"); h_BG = 0.4. Definition, AMGv2_parameter_list.tab: "Humification coefficient of belowground crop residues", type "Real [0-1]" (no unit printed; written dimensionless, C1.1). D194 uses the dataset's 0.4 for h_BG, not the 0.39 of the 2019 text (p. 102). Replaces the draft scoped "main_crop_winter_wheat_belowground", retired to params_borrador/carbono/retirados/. The dataset description says: "They are applicable for average French arable crop conditions." D192 and D197 of issue #77 take them as French defaults, not calibrated for Uruguay, and say so in the label. Per D161 no AI session writes a person's name in checked_by: the lead developer, or their delegate (D66), fills it after comparing the text with the source.
